verdict.rationale: The official Solid repo documents scaffolding a new project from first-party templates with a single command, `npx degit solidjs/templates/js my-app`. Solid also integrates with the Vite ecosystem, which implies a quick run path. This is an official starter, so the core of the story is delivered, but the evidence is thin: a single command mention. Missing for 10: documented run/dev-server steps and setup-time claims, a dedicated official CLI with options (e.g. TypeScript/SSR choices), and independent or hands-on corroboration that setup takes only minutes.
